description: React component for multi-select user addition to a group, with search, pagination, and user status features.

classes.name: AddUserToGroupMultiSelect
classes.description: React component class for multi-select user addition with search and pagination.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a user profile to the selected values and calls addUserCallback if provided.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches profiles not in group or all profiles and loads user statuses on mount.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Removes selected users and calls deleteUserCallback if provided.

methods.name: setUsersLoadingState
methods.description: Sets the loading state for user fetching.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination by fetching next page of profiles.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected user profiles via onSubmitCallback.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs user search with debounce timeout.

methods.name: renderAriaLabel
methods.description: Provides aria label for accessibility based on username.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders individual user options in the multiselect dropdown.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the MultiSelect component with configured props and options.
